summary: Backend + UI testing of INVEST security hardening (random invoice number format, env-based agent seed, re.escape regex searches, TURN creds via env, generic 502 messages). 18/18 pytest tests passed. UI login + Faturas form placeholder (FAT-2026-XXXXXXXX) + invoice creation producing random number (FAT-2026-6D9U9HN2) all verified. Legacy sequential invoices still listed and publicly openable. Test invoices cleaned up.

issues: IBAN inválido warning shown immediately on empty form because placeholder PT50 string looks like a value; submit button is blocked when IBAN mode is selected even though f.bank.iban is actually empty if settings.bank.iban was pre-populated — minor UX friction. Not a security issue.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1758 lines — recommend splitting into modules (auth, invoices, crypto, support, leads) for maintainability.

GET /api/support/ice is unauthenticated and exposes TURN username/credential publicly. Even though these are shared openrelay creds, consider gating behind auth or rotating per-session TURN credentials to avoid relay abuse.
In /api/clients and /api/invoices search, re.escape is correctly applied with 100-char cap — good. Consider also case-folding/stripping input for consistency.
next_invoice_number has a tight while-loop collision check; with 32^8 space collisions are negligible but a safety MAX_ATTEMPTS guard would prevent an unbounded loop in edge cases.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, form placeholder, invoice creation with random number, public link verified)
